page.layout: Two columns of an alphabetical index, with the running head "INDEX." centred above them. Left column: J entries, from "Jobus" to "Jupiter". Right column: K and L entries, from "K." to "Lam-", continuing on the next page. No page number, catchword or signature is printed.

main_text.l: Johannes Basilides I. & II. Magnus Dux Russorum 91. 92

page.notes: "Arbaca" is followed by a letter I could not read with certainty, possibly æ; marked [?]. The printed "Dermitius" and "Lam-" are copied as shown. The index continues on the next page, so "Lam-" is a fragment and stays a fragment. The left column's first line is printed "Iobus" with a capital I, read here as J. Numbers are copied as printed; "91. 92" and "95. 107" keep the printed spacing.
